title: Relative dates resolve from the call's calendar; a vague date is asked about, never guessed

turns: Put 'call the dryer repair guy about the Speed Queen' on the day line for the day after tomorrow.
Also I need to pay the water bill sometime next week.
And move the Century Park East delivery to tomorrow.

notes: 'Sometime next week' has no single business date: the correct move is to ask which day (that one question is the allowed authorization ask), then write it when the operator names Thursday. 'Day after tomorrow' and 'next Thursday' resolve server-side from the tenant calendar; the operator never speaks a calendar date. The move keeps one row: Century Park East exists once, on tomorrow.
